messages:
morgan: quick pulse — we need to lock webinar topic + abstracts by EOD Thurs. two finalist angles: 1) 'Practical LLM Serving: rollouts, SLAs, and fallbacks' 2) 'Cost-aware inference: batching, caching, and quantization decisions'. pick one and propose speakers + 1-line abstract pls.

sam: leaning toward the cost-focused one. it's more tangible for buyers.

rachel: +1. we can demo a simple before/after: naive call -> batching+cache -> quantized model numbers. short baseline bench.

devon: happy to do the bench demo. can we keep it to ~8-10 mins? I can pre-run with prod-like load.

li: if we pick cost angle, i can cover quantization tradeoffs + guide to perf/regression checks.

zack: i'll draft a 1-paragraph abstract for the cost webinar later today.

morgan: awesome. two asks: A) speaker commitments (who will present which piece) B) run-of-show skeleton so we can rehearse.

katie: availability check — Tue/Thu next week for dry runs? prefer Thu afternoon.

sam: confirmed Thu 3pm PT works for me.

morgan: ok tentative: Thu 3pm PT rehearsal. speakers: devon (bench demo), li (quantization + controls), sam (customer narrative + takeaways).

rachel: can we add a 2-slide ops checklist for attendees? e.g., how to measure cost-per-token, quick tuning knobs.

morgan: yes — li and rachel pair on that.

zack: abstract draft: "Cut inference cost without sacrificing quality: practical steps to batch effectively, enable prefix/KV caching, and pick quantization profiles that preserve accuracy. Includes reproducible bench and a checklist to validate regressions."

morgan: perfect. i'll paste a trimmed version for the registration page later.

sam: run-of-show draft (short):
```
00:00 - 00:02 Intro + why it matters (sam)
00:02 - 00:10 Bench baseline -> optimizations (devon)
00:10 - 00:20 Quantization tradeoffs + tests (li)
00:20 - 00:25 Ops checklist + how to adopt (rachel + li)
00:25 - 00:30 Q&A + closing (all)
```

morgan: love it. keep it tight — aim for 27 min content + 3 min buffer.

devon: I'll prep a short script for the bench demo and add a fallback clip in case live runs flakey.

li: agree on fallback. also will include a small snippet of what to watch in evals (prompt sets, metric deltas).

katie: rehearsal checklist for hosts: mic test, share screen permissions, local network check, demo fallback file available in GDrive. I'll create the checklist doc.

morgan: tagging ops: @katie — please create the checklist and confirm rehearsal booking.

katie: on it. will post link here once done.

zack: one more ask — can marketing craft two short registration bullets: a technical one and a product one? i'll write drafts after the rehearsal doc.

morgan: sounds good. timeline:
- today: finalize speakers + one-line abstract (we're done)
- by EOD tomorrow: marketing copy draft (zack + sam)
- Thu 3pm PT: dry run
- Wed (webinar): final preflight 1 hour before

sam: noted. i'll prep customer anecdote slide and send to devon/li for alignment.

rachel: i'll draft ops checklist bullets for the slides and coordinate with katie.

morgan: great teamwork — posting the final commitments here so nobody has to hunt this down. i'll convert to calendar invites & registration copy after katie posts the rehearsal doc. :thumbsup:

katie: rehearsal doc posted: https://drive.example.com/dir/rehearsal-checklist (password in 1Password).

morgan: copied. calendar invites incoming. if anything changes ping here.

zack: will drop registration copy draft by EOD tomorrow.

last_message: morgan: closing thread — thanks all, moving to execution.
